helpPlay: p <idx>              Play a card (you play the dummy's turns too)
rule: There is no auction. Everyone announces their HCP (A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1, always 40 in total) and the pair with more declares, the seat holding more of it becoming declarer. On a 20-20 tie the dealer's side declares; on a seat tie the seat nearest the dealer does. The declarer's partner is the dummy: once the contract is set their hand is face up and the declarer plays both. A contract needs 6 + level tricks.
contractUndecided: Contract: not yet chosen (the declarer picks)
promptContract: You are the declarer. Choose the contract (c <n> <s>).
promptContractWait: The declarer is choosing the contract.
promptPlayDummy: play <idx> ... play from the dummy's hand
promptNext: next ... go to the next deal
hintReasonContract: Sized from the pair's HCP and your longest suit
hintReasonWinTrick: Take the trick -- the contract needs it
hintReasonDummy: It is the dummy's turn, so play from that hand
